answer: Require each identity to commit a distinct, verifiable resource before it can trade: a time-locked storage pledge whose fingerprint is checked on-chain. One inlet accepts only one pledge per fingerprint, so a fable army spun up from a single machine cannot multiply: every fake needs its own pledge, locked for the whole epoch, and quitting early forfeits the deposit. A relic pledge cannot be replayed, because its fingerprint and expiry are already recorded, so mass forgery costs real capital and time while one honest agent pays only once.
